takes/15_mom_b.mp3.txt: Doctor, my son hasn't pooped in a whole week. What's wrong?

takes/16_doctor_a.mp3.txt: That's called constipation. He ate a big meal with soda and almost no water or fiber. Your large intestine pulls water out of food waste. With too little water and fiber, it pulls out too much, so the stool turns hard and dry, and it hurts to push. Drink water every day, eat fruits and veggies, and swap soda for water.
